name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
description: The undead utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the undead that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the undead's next turn.
